capabilities: Render the vault as an interactive 3D force-directed graph
Filter and search nodes with path, tag, file, and text queries
Color-code nodes with rule-based color groups
Customize node shapes, sizes, colors, and physics forces
Open, focus, and drag nodes with mouse and WASD keyboard controls
extras: Offers a beta installation path via the BRAT plugin; the README also links to a blog post about the plugin.
intentEvidence: While other 3D graph plugins exist, this one is built for extreme performance and deep customization
problem: Obsidian's graph visualization offers limited customization and can struggle with large vaults of thousands of notes.
summary: 3D force-directed graph view of the vault, powered by a Rust WebAssembly physics engine with filtering, color groups, and node customization.
